tokens.name: app-bg-top
tokens.usage: App window background gradient, top stop.

tokens.name: app-bg-bottom
tokens.usage: App window background gradient, bottom stop.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar and main EQ panel fill.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, dropdowns, preset name field, fader/slider track fill.

tokens.name: border-panel
tokens.usage: 1px border around panels, inputs and bordered groups (e.g. the Preset unit).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline rules: title bar bottom edge, fader guide lines, list separators.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, numeric values, active labels, primary body text on surface-panel and app-bg.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Section labels (PRESET, TONE, LIMITER), control row labels, inactive/idle state text.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels and hint text on dimmed rows.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons set on filled accent-teal surfaces (primary button label, active preset chip).

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active/enabled toggle fill, active preset state, focus ring. Reserve for the one primary action or state per view -- never a general decoration color.

tokens.name: accent-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, inactive slider handles, neutral icon glyphs.

tokens.name: signal-safe
tokens.usage: Fader and level-meter fill while gain sits below the limiter's caution threshold.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: Fader and level-meter fill as gain approaches the limiter ceiling; warning banner icon and border accent.

tokens.name: signal-danger
tokens.usage: Fader and level-meter fill once boost is within 1 dB of the limiter budget or clipping; danger text (>=4.5:1 on surface-panel); destructive action emphasis (Delete Preset hover/focus).

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the warning banner and other caution-level surfaces.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on the warning banner and caution badges.

tokens.name: track-fill
tokens.usage: Unfilled portion of a fader, slider or meter track.

tokens.name: toggle-track-off
tokens.usage: Toggle switch track in the off state; always drawn with a 1px track-guide outline so the switch is visible against the panel.

tokens.name: toggle-track-on
tokens.usage: Toggle switch track in the on state.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on every interactive control, 2px offset outline.

tokens.name: track-guide
tokens.usage: Visible (>=3:1 on both surface-panel and surface-raised) fader rail, zero-dB tick, the 1px outline of an off toggle and the resting border of text inputs and dropdowns -- the parts of a control that must be seen to be used.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The "AudioTune Pro" wordmark in the header.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: The "System-Wide Equalizer" line beside the wordmark, set in text-secondary.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase sidebar and panel section headers: PRESET, TONE, LIMITER -- CLIPPING PROTECTION, SYSTEM MIX (PRE-EQ), 10-BAND GRAPHIC EQ.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Dropdown values, text-input content (preset name field).

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: Row labels beside a toggle or slider: Bass, Treble, Preamp, Auto-gain protection, Equalizer enabled.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Text inside buttons: Save As, Get Equalizer APO, Delete Preset, Reset.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text under a control group, e.g. the estimated-peak line.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: Sidebar numeric readouts: Bass/Treble/Preamp dB values, Ceiling dB value.

styles.name: value-sm
styles.usage: The dB value printed above each of the 10 EQ faders.

styles.name: freq-label
styles.usage: Frequency labels below each EQ fader: 31, 62, 125 ... 16k.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight control padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a slider handle and its numeric value; toggle internal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked controls inside one sidebar section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel internal padding; gap between sidebar sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the two Tone/Limiter blocks; button internal horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sidebar and main-panel edge padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Title-bar-to-header and header-to-content vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the sidebar column and the main EQ panel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fader handles, slider handles, toggle knobs, meter fill caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text inputs, dropdowns, badges.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the bordered Preset unit, the warning banner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggle switch track and knob, pill badges.

tokens.name: elevation-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar and main EQ panel, to read as raised off the window background.

tokens.name: elevation-popover
tokens.usage: Preset dropdown menu and any floating overlay.
